name: Xiaomi Mijia thermometers
description: Mijia Reader sensor family: MJ_HT_V1 advertisement objects, and LYWSD03MMC, LYWSD02, and MHO-C401 GATT readings.
author: BLESPloit
notes: All four models advertise service data 0xFE95 and are selected by exact GAP name. V1 MJ_HT_V1 (usual product id 0x01AA) is not connected: the app reads one object at byte offset 11 — 0x1004 temperature, 0x1006 humidity, 0x100A battery, or 0x100D both — with values in units of 0.1. V2 LYWSD03MMC (0x055B; frame 0x5830, capability 0x08 or 0x28 plus 01 00) and V4 MHO-C401 (0x0387) subscribe to ebe0ccc1-7a0a-4b0c-8a1a-6ff2997da3a6: int16 LE temperature in 0.01°C, uint8 humidity, uint16 LE battery millivolts, percent = mV * 100 / 3100. V3 LYWSD02 (0x045B) uses that notification for temperature and humidity only; battery percent is the first byte of ebe0ccc4-… and the clock is unix seconds on ebe0ccb7-…. Clock write is not simulated. Set vars.model to MJ_HT_V1, LYWSD03MMC (default), LYWSD02, or MHO-C401 and restart the peripheral. Frame-control bit 0x08 means the advertisement object is sealed with a Mi Home bind key; the observer records that as mi_home_bound and keeps the scan row as Mi Sensor, because the GATT reading stays in the clear.
